name: Sachin VWAP Confluence
description: A 1-minute XAUUSD strategy based on VWAP crossovers confirmed by three momentum filters: CCI(20) > 0, MACD(12,26,9) histogram > 0, and price above EMA(33) for longs (all inverted for shorts). A noise filter requires the closing price to be at least minClear points beyond VWAP, and a cooldown prevents re-entry within coolBars bars of the last signal. Stop-loss is set at the tighter of a fixed max-stop distance or the lowest low (highest high for shorts) of the last n bars. 50% of the position is closed at 2R; the remaining 50% is trailed by 1× the initial SL distance. Sized at 1% equity risk per trade.
buy_condition: 1) ta.crossover(close, vwap) on the current bar; 2) close > vwap + min_clear; 3) CCI(cci_period, hlc3) > 0; 4) MACD(macd_fast, macd_slow, macd_signal) histogram > 0; 5) close > EMA(ema_period); 6) bars since last signal (long or short) > cool_bars. All conditions must be true simultaneously. Enter long at the NEXT bar open.
sell_condition: SHORT entry (mirror): 1) ta.crossunder(close, vwap); 2) close < vwap - min_clear; 3) CCI < 0; 4) MACD histogram < 0; 5) close < EMA(ema_period); 6) cooldown satisfied. Enter short at NEXT bar open. Exit (both sides): (a) SL hit; (b) 50% partial close when price reaches entry ± 2 × SL_distance (TP1); (c) remaining 50% trailed by 1 × SL_distance from the high-water mark after TP1 is hit.
tp_sl_strategy: For LONG: SL_distance = min(max_stop_pts, entry_price - lowest_low(sl_lookback bars before entry)). SL price = entry - SL_distance. TP1 price = entry + 2 × SL_distance → close 50% of position (fraction=0.5) at next bar open after TP1 is reached. After TP1: activate trailing stop on remaining 50% with trail distance = 1 × SL_distance (trails intrabar from the peak). For SHORT: mirror all directions. Max stop cap (max_stop_pts) and lookback (sl_lookback) are tunable parameters.
risk_management: Risk 1% of current equity per trade. Lot size = (equity × risk_pct / 100) / (SL_distance × 100). Maximum leverage cap of 20×. Minimum lot step 0.01. Only one open position at a time.

parameters.name: min_clear
parameters.help: Minimum distance (pts) the close must be beyond VWAP for a valid cross signal

parameters.name: cool_bars
parameters.help: Cooldown in bars after any signal (long or short) before a new signal is allowed

parameters.name: ema_period
parameters.help: Period for the EMA trend filter

parameters.name: cci_period
parameters.help: Period for the CCI momentum filter (applied to hlc3)

parameters.name: sl_lookback
parameters.help: Number of bars to look back for the swing low (long) or swing high (short) to anchor the stop-loss

parameters.name: max_stop_pts
parameters.help: Maximum allowed stop-loss distance in points; SL = min(max_stop_pts, swing-based distance)

parameters.name: risk_pct
parameters.help: Percentage of equity risked per trade for position sizing

parameters.name: max_leverage
parameters.help: Maximum leverage cap applied to computed lot size

notes: 1. VWAP is session-anchored (daily reset) computed from hlc3, matching TradingView's built-in ta.vwap(hlc3). 2. The swing-low SL lookback uses the lowest low of the sl_lookback bars immediately before entry (not including the entry bar) to avoid look-ahead. 3. The TP1 partial close and trailing stop activation both execute at the next bar open after the threshold is breached intrabar — this is a one-position engine so no pyramiding. 4. The cooldown timer resets on both long and short signals. 5. MACD histogram = MACD line minus signal line.
